title: MOF Signal Surface
subtitle: MAF, art, and substrate discovery rendered as a living document
summary: This example turns a fast-moving semantic bundle into a reviewable artifact. The weighted lexicon stays attached to provenance, the favorite words stay visible, and the result can be tuned into motion without losing the shape of the original signal.

sections.heading: Intent
sections.body: Make the hidden shape visible. Words should carry semantic weight, remain attached to their source lineage, and be available as living material for motion, notebooks, and CHIT-adjacent surfaces.

sections.heading: Operator Mode
sections.body: Use the render when you want to inspect how a phrase clusters before indexing or before turning it into audiovisual output. The artifact is not just a report; it is a staging surface for tuning the spectra.
